name: JoAi: Update Stats

description.en: View summary counts for your team updates, including deals, events, news, articles, and jobs. Use this to understand how much active customer-facing content is available across connected websites and public feeds.
description.de: Zeige zusammengefasste Zahlen für Team-Updates, inklusive Angeboten, Events, News, Artikeln und Jobs. So siehst du, wie viele kundenrelevante Inhalte auf verbundenen Websites und öffentlichen Feeds verfügbar sind.

bot: Use this when the user asks how many updates, deals, events, news, articles, or jobs the team has.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.

success.en: Updates: {{DEALS_COUNT}} deals, {{EVENTS_COUNT}} events, {{NEWS_COUNT}} news, {{ARTICLES_COUNT}} articles, {{JOBS_COUNT}} jobs.
success.de: Updates: {{DEALS_COUNT}} Angebote, {{EVENTS_COUNT}} Events, {{NEWS_COUNT}} News, {{ARTICLES_COUNT}} Artikel, {{JOBS_COUNT}} Jobs.
